items.title: Can United Airlines Holdings (UAL) Still Be A Bargain On Cash Flow?
items.summary: United Airlines Holdings has delivered a sharp multi year rebound in its share price, and recent headlines around aircraft reliability and in flight services keep the story in focus. The open question for you is whether the cash being generated by the airline can support where the stock trades today. items.title: What Is United Airlines Holdings (UAL) Doing About The 737 MAX Software Glitch?
items.summary: United Airlines Holdings (NasdaqGS:UAL) confirmed a Boeing 737 MAX software glitch affecting landing navigation systems has been identified in recent testing. The carrier stated that none of its actively flying 737 MAX aircraft use the affected software version, limiting immediate operational disruption. United is working with Boeing and the FAA to request earlier software versions for incoming 737 MAX deliveries while the issue is addressed. The push for alternative 737 MAX software on new...

items.title: Which Airline Stock Dominated in September: American, United, or Delta?
items.summary: Three major airlines faced the same turbulent September, but one carrier broke sharply from the pack while another sank deeper into trouble. The gap between winner and loser tells a story about which airline model investors actually trust right now.

items.title: The Delta-SpaceX Feud Just Escalated. Investors Beware.
items.summary: The spat between  SpaceX  CEO Elon Musk and  Delta Air Lines  CEO Ed Bastian is escalating.  Delta passed on Starlink in the spring, opting for  Amazon.com’s  space-based broadband product, called Amazon Leo.  Delta now uses T-Mobile, with the help of Viasat, and will roll out Leo in 2028.
